referenceSources.description:
An orange MG F Cup convertible is showcased on a paved surface with lush greenery behind it. The car features black alloy wheels, a white hardtop, and distinctive racing decals such as "MGF / TF Specialists," "MG Car Club," and "Trophy Series D." The front bumper displays the license plate P846 SVW, and contact details like "01932 241843" and "churchsgarageautos.com" are visible on the side.

This image appears on Espíritu RACER’s "MG F Cup" page, part of a Spanish automotive magazine dedicated to car news and tests. The site includes contributions from automotive enthusiasts and professionals—Pablo Mayo, Javi Martín, Jesús Alonso, Javier Gutiérrez, and Jose Manuel Miana—who bring engineering insights, historical context, and personal passion to their coverage of the MG F Cup racing series.
